description: We call our proposed board BTRboard. Builders are asking if it can replace both OSB and housewrap while also providing continuous exterior insulation. We have not specified its composition, thickness, structural function or joint details here. What should we send before you decide whether a variance is needed?
known_facts: intended to replace OSB and housewrap and provide exterior insulation
material, thickness, structural function and joints unspecified

missing_info.field: material composition, rigidity, moisture behaviour and joint system
missing_info.why: Determine whether the membrane-replacement permission can apply.

missing_info.field: structural role, lateral system, cladding fastening and backing needs
missing_info.why: Membrane permission is separate from sheathing and structural requirements.

missing_info.field: thermal resistance, air leakage, vapour permeance, layer order and design climate
missing_info.why: Determine material-positioning applicability without inventing branded-product properties.

missing_info.field: intended building types, storeys, areas and application scope
missing_info.why: Resolve Part 9 versus Part 3 and project or jurisdiction-wide scope.

should_cite.why: Joint details are a separate condition.
Cladding may require sheathing or solid backing.
Structural lateral resistance is a distinct question.

gold.engineering_reason: A product name does not establish a building exemption or a structural design route; the intended work and design basis are unknown.
